entry.title: v4.5.0-rc1: Merge pull request #15932 from omacom/notifications-omapager
v4.0.6
entry.content:
This patch release resolves a few small hiccups specific users encountered with v4.0.5.

You can upgrade existing machines with Update > Omarchy.

Install on new machines with the ISO:

  • Download: https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.6.iso
  • SHA256: b542db5fecc37395d9af6654a8146ebed225f275ae4d5a6fcf432e40afe7bb88

Fixes

  • Fix updates stopping at the OpenClaw migration from 4.0.5 by @spencerbull in #14212
  • Fix the OpenClaw move stopping updates when you have your own OpenClaw by @emirb in #15875
  • Fix the screen sometimes not locking before suspend by @dhh in #14978
  • Fix the boot passphrase prompt using a non-Latin keyboard layout by @kevincardwell in #14885
  • Fix updates stopping at the console migration when the Limine config replaces the kernel command line by @omarchybot in #15852
  • Fix TUXEDO laptop drivers failing to build on the Omarchy kernel by @bastidotnet in omacom/omarchy-pkgs#1244

Full Changelog: v4.0.5...v4.0.6

If you installed OpenClaw yourself

If ~/.local/bin/openclaw is your own npm install, the update leaves it alone and doesn't move Omarchy's OpenClaw, and after a reboot the OpenClaw gateway fails to start. To finish the move, run:

mv ~/.local/bin/openclaw ~/.local/bin/openclaw.mine && systemctl --user reset-failed openclaw-gateway.service && omarchy-install-openclaw-cli --now && systemctl --user start openclaw-gateway.service

entry.title: v4.0.5
entry.content:
This release brings a bunch of fixes and refinements to tighten things up as we prep for the next feature release coming soon. Under the hood, it also moves Omarchy onto Qt 6.12, bumps the packages on the stable ring, and brings an updated Omarchy kernel with BORE scheduler.

You can upgrade existing machines with Update > Omarchy.

Install on new machines with the ISO:

  • Download: https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.5.iso
  • SHA256: 73fd4334f1f67b19cd8a5589f9363173fc3aec07c0a59f198833eaddb66877a1

Improvements

  • Improve reliability of Wi-Fi QR code generation by @dhh in #12748
  • Make Hermes and OpenClaw agents self-updating by @spencerbull in #12844
  • Improve bar performance and shell restart speed by @silversword411 in #11015
  • Speed up browser and web app launches by @dhh in #13520
  • Reduce system update time by skipping redundant keyring refreshes by @dhh in #15034
  • Update the default kernel to Linux 7.2.8 with the BORE scheduler by @kwilczynski in omacom/omarchy-pkgs#1231
  • Update Arch packages to the October snapshot, including Qt 6.12
  • Prioritize Omarchy's package repository over Arch's by @dhh in #14551
  • Improve clipboard yanks and pastes in Neovim over SSH by @dhh in #11486
  • Update GitHub links to omacom/omarchy by @dhh in #11707

Fixes

  • Fix built-in speaker support for Dell XPS 13 Panther Lake by @spencerbull in #14017
  • Prevent KEF LSX II LT USB speakers from locking up by @dhh in #11318
  • Optimize NVIDIA environment variables for hybrid laptops by @Yarlord in #11690
  • Fix persistent firewall rules when disabling SSH by @AFOliveira in #13048
  • Fix script execution failures in third-party plugins by @joewinke in #11925
  • Prevent lid closure from interrupting system shutdown by @chemineer1 in #13076
  • Improve audio sink resolution for EasyEffects 8 by @stefanoverna, @omarchybot in #13396
  • Fix Windows VM launch failures caused by directory permissions by @atoslins in #12323
  • Fix Steam installation picking incorrect graphics drivers by @selfcrypto in #12569
  • Fix black screen hang during boot on some systems by @emirb in #14771
  • Fix calendar grid errors in specific time zones by @omarchybot in #10476
  • Ensure clicked links focus the browser window by @dhh in #14441
  • Fix the shell's colors and panels breaking under Qt 6.12 by @dhh in #14553
  • Fix third-party shell plugins breaking under Qt 6.12 by @outfoxxed in #14845
  • Fix lock recovery taking over a session another locker may hold by @dhh in #15020
  • Fix agent usage limits not resetting when their window ends by @dhh in #14225
  • Fix the Display panel's toggle for turning a monitor on or off by @houz42 in #13725
  • Fix an idle timeout of 0 locking immediately instead of disabling it by @paulogeyer in #12538
  • Fix speaker tuning not getting realtime audio priority by @michaeldeby in #12958
  • Fix EasyEffects filters that use separate input and output nodes by @omarchybot in #14241
  • Fix T2 Mac installs missing the Broadcom firmware fetcher by @SorenHJohansen in #13963
  • Fix removing RetroArch leaving its database package behind by @Bartok9 in #12839
  • Fix the swap label spacing in Fastfetch by @MicahelE in #12774

Security

  • Remove unsafe automatic PATH injection in project directories by @ErikMelton in #11336
  • Ensure root password hashes are erased during factory reset by @AksharP5 in #10379
  • Harden helper scripts against malicious command-line flags by @lalvarezt in #11495

Full Changelog: v4.0.4...v4.0.5

entry.title: v4.0.4
entry.content:
This release brings our bespoke kernel to everyone. The Omarchy kernel is tuned to keep the desktop responsive and multitasking smooth, even under heavy load or memory pressure. It improves gaming compatibility, enables smoother gaming on supported AMD HDMI displays, speeds up common Btrfs file operations, and refines power management. It also fixes everyday hardware frustrations, including missing audio, unresponsive touchpads, display freezes, and slow startup or resume on affected machines.

You can upgrade existing machines with Update > Omarchy.

Install on new machines with the ISO:

Download: https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.4.iso
SHA256: ddeded2758c48318d201dfdac905ecb28f570441883f0c052ea3cd5d05acf92d

Improvements

  • Install our bespoke kernel and set linux-omarchy as the default boot option by @kwilczynski

Fixes

  • Fix webcam issues on XPS systems in the 7.2.x kernel by @spencerbull

Full Changelog: v4.0.3...v4.0.4

entry.title: v4.0.3
entry.content:
This release brings amazing out-of-the-box integration for both Hermes and Openclaw as well as additional set of security fixes that were validated and examined by the Omarchy Security team. If you ever find security issues with Omarchy, please follow the responsible disclosure procedure on omarchy.org/security. 🙏

You can upgrade existing machines with Update > Omarchy.

Install on new machines with the ISO:

Download: https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.3.iso
SHA256: 03d60bc74306dca51f96e1a84b690871d8d606826b260edd0208962da8507d14

Additional agentware is here

Add OpenClaw as a desktop app and default coding agent by @spencerbull

Install OpenClaw from Install > AI, open its Control UI as an app, or choose its terminal interface as your default agent. Omarchy manages onboarding and the local user gateway; removal asks before deleting your data.

Add Hermes Desktop and terminal-agent integration by @spencerbull and @smfworks

Install Hermes from Install > AI and use the same installation from the desktop, terminal, and default-agent launcher. Prompted sessions use the native interactive interface, and Omarchy skills are linked into Hermes.

More agents, more everywhere!

  • Add T3 Code with Omarchy theme support by @omarchybot, @ryanrhughes
  • Add the Perplexity desktop app to the AI menu by @spencerbull
  • Add Cursor CLI as a default coding agent by @dhh, @cavanaug
  • Add Muse Code as a default coding agent by @jp30566347, @dhh

Compatibility

  • Improve fingerprint-reader support during setup by @powderluv
  • Update the Panther Lake kernel to 7.2.3 by @ryanrhughes

Fixes

  • Fix mise upgrades removing tool versions still in use by @dhh
  • Fix oversized 1Password windows on scaled displays by @dhh
  • Switch Broadcom Wi-Fi to the DKMS driver after Arch dropped the prebuilt module by @ryanrhughes

Security

  • Harden mise command-wrapper input handling by @Adolanium
  • Restrict plugin access to authentication services by @acrogenesis, @barmstrong, @ryanrhughes
  • Require expiry setup for temporary passwordless sudo by @ErikMelton
  • Harden locate indexing with packaged service defaults by @ryanrhughes
  • Harden ownership of installed sleep hooks by @acrogenesis
  • Harden lock-screen authentication command lookup by @mdisec
  • Restrict Kitty remote control to local sockets by @ryanrhughes
